title: Bear Set

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Bear Set is a Black Forest-tier armor set. It has a lower armor value than the Bronze Armor, but a higher armor value than the Troll Set. However, wearing all 3 pieces provides the Berserk set bonus, increasing damage, stamina and health regeneration, but making the wearer slightly more vulnerable to physical damage.
Each normal Bear drops 4 Bear hides, so it will require a minimum of 4 Bear kills to craft the full set. Considering the 10% drop chance on the Bear trophy it could potentially require many more bears.

Bear Set

Introduction. The Bear Set is a Black Forest-tier armor set. It has a lower armor value than the Bronze Armor, but a higher armor value than the Troll Set. However, wearing all 3 pieces provides the Berserk set bonus, increasing damage, stamina and health regeneration, but making the wearer slightly more vulnerable to physical damage.
Each normal Bear drops 4 Bear hides, so it will require a minimum of 4 Bear kills to craft the full set. Considering the 10% drop chance on the Bear trophy it could potentially require many more bears.
